messages:
marta: Heads up — need to land sdk#412, api#701, and helm#88 in that order to keep staging canary healthy. Propose a merge window 11:00–11:30 PT today. Who can shepherd approvals?
kevin: I can review sdk#412 this morning. tagging @sophie for the API change review.
sophie: On it. api#701 is blocked by a small schema tweak — leaving a comment now. @marta can you confirm this is additive/backwards-compatible for console?
marta: Confirmed: schema is additive, console behavior unchanged. If console needs a trivial PR I can cut it. Plan: kevin merges SDK, then I merge API, then leo applies helm chart.
leo: I can do helm after api merge. I'll keep canary at 50% and watch metrics. deploy-bot — can you post the canary schedule?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z, 50% traffic for 15m. Monitoring: /observability/canary. Alerts will trigger if error rate > 2%.
kevin: Left one tiny nit in sdk#412 (naming on the helper). Should be quick to fix.
marta: Fixed the nit and force-pushed. Kevin, ping me when you approve so I can proceed with API merge.
kevin: :thumbsup: Approved and merging now. sdk#412 merged at 11:08 PT.
sophie: API looks good after addressing mocks, approving. Merging api#701 at 11:12 PT.
leo: Applying helm at 11:18 PT. Command I'm running: ```helm upgrade --install redwood-runtime ./charts/runtime --set image.tag=canary-20260317 --namespace staging```
deploy-bot: Helm upgrade initiated at 11:18 PT, release: redwood-runtime-canary-42. Tracking rollout.
leo: Canary stable at 50% after 5m: no spike in errors, p50 latency unchanged. Will roll to 100% in ~10m unless objections.
marta: No objections. Great coordination, thanks all — I'll update the release notes and ping CS. :tada:
kevin: Adding links for traceability: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412  https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/701  https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/88
